description: SYNTHETIC claim-verification set for claim_aware_rag_test_document.pdf. Gold labels were assigned by the project author (single annotator) relative to the document only, not to real-world truth. A claim with a false component is labelled CONTRADICTED; a causal claim whose effect is stated but whose cause is absent from the document is labelled PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED. Small (n=30); treat results as a sanity check, not a benchmark.

claims.label: SUPPORTED

claims.label: SUPPORTED

claims.label: SUPPORTED

claims.label: SUPPORTED
